encounters.prose_label: Outrigger fishing village wakeup
encounters.sensory_hook: Hollow paddle-thump on bangka hulls, rooster answering rooster, coconut-husk smoke

encounters.prose_label: Nakhoda shooting the Pole Star with a kamal
encounters.sensory_hook: Knotted cord held to the teeth, Canopus low over the palm line

encounters.prose_label: Wet-monsoon squall line approach
encounters.sensory_hook: Cicadas fall silent first; metallic ozone smell; a grey wall walking on rain-legs

encounters.prose_label: Pumice raft scraping the hull
encounters.sensory_hook: Sulfurous rotten-egg reek, porous grey stones clacking like bones along the waterline

encounters.prose_label: Ash fall from a distant eruption
encounters.sensory_hook: Grey sugar on deck plank, Pele's hair glinting in rigging, sun reddened to clove-bud

encounters.prose_label: Saltwater crocodile on a mudbank
encounters.sensory_hook: Wet-cloth slither into black water, mangrove roots ticking with retreating crabs

encounters.prose_label: Flying fox flight at sundown
encounters.sensory_hook: Leather-creak of wings overhead, sky stitched east-to-west toward clove groves

encounters.prose_label: Reef bommie nearly struck
encounters.sensory_hook: Jurumudi's shout, sudden jade-to-turquoise shallowing, triggerfish scattering

encounters.prose_label: Phosphorescence in the wake
encounters.sensory_hook: Paddle stirs cold green fire; every fish a comet beneath the hull

encounters.prose_label: Harbor-duty payment at a datu's stair
encounters.sensory_hook: Lacquer tray of areca and betel, slaked-lime chalk on the tongue, brass weights clinking

encounters.prose_label: Gamelan drifting from the datu's pavilion
encounters.sensory_hook: Slow bronze intervals over water, answered by muezzin-analog and junk's bell

encounters.prose_label: Sea snake (Hydrophis spp.) on the surface
encounters.sensory_hook: Banded ribbon drifting past the outrigger, unhurried, indifferent

encounters.prose_label: Pirate-prahu on the horizon
encounters.sensory_hook: Low sail against the sunrise, the nakhoda quietly loosening the kris at his sash

encounters.prose_label: Clove or nutmeg grove downwind of anchorage
encounters.sensory_hook: Sweet-smoky Syzygium aromaticum over the water, mixed with wood fire and drying mace

encounters.prose_label: Landfall at a multi-quarter entrepot
encounters.sensory_hook: Three quarters visible: Muslim merchants, junk-masters, palm-thatch longhouses of the datu

encounters.prose_label: Sperm whale blowing in a deep strait
encounters.sensory_hook: Twin spout against the bearing-line, the long slick where it sounded

encounters.prose_label: Giant manta banking under the hull
encounters.sensory_hook: A thrown-cloak shadow over the reef pass, white-shouldered, soundless

encounters.prose_label: Whale shark idling through baitfish
encounters.sensory_hook: Broad as a hatch-cover, star-spotted hide, the nakhoda calling it harmless

encounters.prose_label: Fish eagle pair calling from a dead acacia
encounters.sensory_hook: Yelping whistle thrown between perches, carrying across still water

encounters.prose_label: Pirogue hawking smoked catfish to passing boats
encounters.sensory_hook: Shout of "Ndje! Ndje!" and a whiff of palm-smoke and river-mud

encounters.prose_label: Hippo pod blocking the channel
encounters.sensory_hook: Wet bellows-grunt, nostrils like twin cookpots breaking the surface

encounters.prose_label: Nile crocodile basking at a wash-place
encounters.sensory_hook: The boy who steps, wordless, between you and what looked just like a small boat

encounters.prose_label: Papyrus-pounders on the foreshore
encounters.sensory_hook: Slapping chorus of mallets; air smells of rye-bread and damp leather

encounters.prose_label: Women pounding grain in wooden mortars
encounters.sensory_hook: Double-beat thud rolling between compounds like a second heartbeat

encounters.prose_label: Frog chorus at the first rain
encounters.sensory_hook: A deafening pulse that drowns conversation within two paces

encounters.prose_label: Mosquito column at sunset over a side-channel
encounters.sensory_hook: The air itself seems to hum and sting

encounters.prose_label: Ferry crossing choked with cotton bales
encounters.sensory_hook: Creak of reed bindings, paddle-splash, smell of raw indigo and sweat

encounters.prose_label: Saddle-billed stork hunting a drying pool
encounters.sensory_hook: Absolute stillness, then a dagger-strike into silver water

encounters.prose_label: Caravanserai-on-stilts at a river landing
encounters.sensory_hook: Lamp-oil, mosquito smoke, drum-line announcing arrivals

encounters.prose_label: Nile monitor raiding a fish-rack
encounters.sensory_hook: Black tongue flick, scatter of racked fish, women's curses

encounters.prose_label: Spawning run of Nile perch through flooded rice
encounters.sensory_hook: Silver thrashing between rice-stems; children spearing by torchlight

encounters.prose_label: Cattle grazing the cracked riverbed
encounters.sensory_hook: Dust-haze, lowing, the smell of hot clay and dried dung

encounters.prose_label: West African manatee surfacing
encounters.sensory_hook: A soft exhalation; boatmen fall silent and touch the gunwale for luck

encounters.prose_label: Rock python digesting on the levee path
encounters.sensory_hook: Coils thick as a man's thigh; the caravan detours without comment

encounters.prose_label: Chasqui runner overtaking the caravan
encounters.sensory_hook: White feather sunshade bobbing, blown conch pututu, gone before the dust settles

encounters.prose_label: Quipucamayuq tallying loads at a tambo
encounters.sensory_hook: Coloured knots running through calloused fingers by torchlight

encounters.prose_label: Llama train grunting up stone steps
encounters.sensory_hook: Humming nasal complaints, soft pad of split hooves on paving

encounters.prose_label: Q'iswa chaka grass bridge over gorge
encounters.sensory_hook: The creak of ichu rope, the white thread of river far below

encounters.prose_label: Vicuna herd on the puna
encounters.sensory_hook: Fawn backs flickering against silver grass, then a whistle and they are gone

encounters.prose_label: Andean condor at the pass
encounters.sensory_hook: The slow audible woof of wingbeat at arm's reach

encounters.prose_label: Soroche attack at the apacheta cairn
encounters.sensory_hook: Hammering skull, a porter squatting with a coca quid in his cheek

encounters.prose_label: Puya raimondii in full bloom
encounters.sensory_hook: A ten-metre spire of ivory flowers, bees audible from fifty paces

encounters.prose_label: Spectacled bear (Tremarctos ornatus) sign in yungas
encounters.sensory_hook: Claw-scored bark on a wax-palm, a smell like wet dog

encounters.prose_label: Chuno-making at puna tambo
encounters.sensory_hook: Small potatoes laid on ichu mats, rimed hard by morning, trampled at noon

encounters.prose_label: Flamingos at a salt lake
encounters.sensory_hook: Pink absurdity against blinding white crust, quiet clatter of bills

encounters.prose_label: Quena flute at the tambo fire
encounters.sensory_hook: A single falling note held against the wind, nothing answering

encounters.prose_label: Landslide across the paved road
encounters.sensory_hook: Fresh red earth, a buried switchback, porters unloading to clamber

encounters.prose_label: Quenua grove at the tree-limit
encounters.sensory_hook: Papery red bark peeling in curls, the highest wood in the world

encounters.prose_label: Puma sign at dawn near camp
encounters.sensory_hook: A pad-print in frost, claws sheathed, the arriero spitting once

encounters.prose_label: Wind in the feather-grass
encounters.sensory_hook: A continuous silver hiss that becomes, by noon, the only sound in the world

encounters.prose_label: Marmot whistle-alarm from a burrow-mound
encounters.sensory_hook: A single sharp pipe from a mound rimmed with wormwood

encounters.prose_label: Yam post-station arrival
encounters.sensory_hook: Three hundred horses dozing in a dust-lot; a clerk checks your paiza by lamplight

encounters.prose_label: Three-bowl kumis greeting in a felt tent
encounters.sensory_hook: Sour-sweet mare's milk, flicked three times for sky, wind, and earth

encounters.prose_label: Dust-plume on the horizon (herd, storm, or raiders?)
encounters.sensory_hook: Guide stands in his stirrups, silent a long minute, before naming it

encounters.prose_label: Saker falcon cry out of an empty sky
encounters.sensory_hook: A dry, tearing scream directly overhead

encounters.prose_label: Biting flies on horse withers
encounters.sensory_hook: Red streaks below the mane; the horse shudders its whole hide in a wave

encounters.prose_label: Wolf-howl chorus at dusk
encounters.sensory_hook: One note lifts; four answer from different compass points; the hobbled horses go still

encounters.prose_label: Swollen river ford (summer runoff)
encounters.sensory_hook: Brown water to the saddle-skirt; the camel bawls once and finds its footing

encounters.prose_label: Karakurt spider in bedding
encounters.sensory_hook: A bite you never felt; by second watch, cramping abdomen and sweat-sheen

encounters.prose_label: Great bustard flush from a hollow
encounters.sensory_hook: A whump of heavy wings thirty paces ahead

encounters.prose_label: Throat-singing at the fire
encounters.sensory_hook: A drone like a bowstring and a whistle above it, from one man's single throat

encounters.prose_label: Dzeren gazelle stampede
encounters.sensory_hook: A tan river of animals pouring over a rise, gone in under a minute

encounters.prose_label: Brigand band shadowing from a ridge
encounters.sensory_hook: Six horsemen at skyline for an afternoon; never closing; gone by moonrise

encounters.prose_label: Zud ground-blizzard under a blue sky
encounters.sensory_hook: Knee-high snow hissing sideways while overhead the sun is a hard clean disk

encounters.prose_label: Golden eagle stoop on corsac fox
encounters.sensory_hook: A black cross folds and falls; a fox screams once in the grass

encounters.prose_label: Ground hornbill dawn duet
encounters.sensory_hook: Two-note bass boom rolling 4 km across wet grass, pair at different pitches

encounters.prose_label: Smith relighting bloomery at dzimbahwe
encounters.sensory_hook: Slow hammer-on-anvil against stone, charcoal reek, tuyere glowing cherry

encounters.prose_label: Cattle driven from kraal to water
encounters.sensory_hook: Dust column, low lowing, a boy's short-long whistle, hooves on baked laterite

encounters.prose_label: Cicada wall-of-sound under umbrella-thorn
encounters.sensory_hook: The air itself vibrates; shirt salt-stiff with sweat

encounters.prose_label: Baobab on horizon
encounters.sensory_hook: A single fat silhouette like an up-ended root, visible a day's walk off

encounters.prose_label: Tsetse-belt detour
encounters.sensory_hook: Lead porter turns uphill; murmur of "no oxen beyond this line"

encounters.prose_label: Hyena whoop
encounters.sensory_hook: Rising woo-OOP from outside the firelight, then silence

encounters.prose_label: Lion roar carrying from the plains
encounters.sensory_hook: Distant bass rolling through the ground; porters stop talking mid-sentence

encounters.prose_label: Leopard cough at the kraal wall
encounters.sensory_hook: Dry saw-rasp no louder than a cough; a dog gone in the morning

encounters.prose_label: Elephant crop-raid at village margin
encounters.sensory_hook: Trampled millet, a torn granary stilt, sweet rotting smell of broken stalks at dawn

encounters.prose_label: Cattle-raiders striking a waystation kraal
encounters.sensory_hook: Whistle-signals from kopje watch, spears clattering from thatch

encounters.prose_label: Grass fire on the dry-season horizon
encounters.sensory_hook: Brown smear of smoke, sable and zebra drifting ahead of the flame

encounters.prose_label: Gold-panner at a plateau stream
encounters.sensory_hook: Man squatting over a wooden dish, silt swirling, a quill-length of gold at his belt

encounters.prose_label: Black mamba or puff adder on path
encounters.sensory_hook: A porter's shout, everyone frozen; the mamba flowing off like spilled oil

encounters.prose_label: Arrival at gold-trade dzimbahwe
encounters.sensory_hook: Mortarless granite catching low light; scent of cattle, millet-beer, Arab incense

encounters.prose_label: Qeturin wind-reader testing grain-drift
encounters.sensory_hook: Gravel sifting through fingers, a sniff for qibli metal-smell

encounters.prose_label: Loading of salt-slabs to rahab flanks
encounters.sensory_hook: Palm-rope creak, dull chalk-clack of slab on slab

encounters.prose_label: Oasis adhan-analog call drifting over date palms
encounters.sensory_hook: A single human voice threading the silence

encounters.prose_label: Mirage lake on hammada horizon
encounters.sensory_hook: Silver that recedes at the pace you walk

encounters.prose_label: Black reg "that eats shoes"
encounters.sensory_hook: Stones ticking as they heat, sole-leather scored to ribbon

encounters.prose_label: Dune sastrugi under a hissing wind
encounters.sensory_hook: The erg's one sound — sand over sand, no birds

encounters.prose_label: Fennec call beyond the dung-fire
encounters.sensory_hook: A thin yip, answered once, then the stars

encounters.prose_label: Scorpion in an upturned boot
encounters.sensory_hook: Tap, shake, the dry scuttle onto sand

encounters.prose_label: Horned viper buried beside a bedroll
encounters.sensory_hook: Two eye-dots and a horn-tip level with the grain

encounters.prose_label: Libyco-Berber peckings at a foggara outlet
encounters.sensory_hook: Cold stone, ochre lichen, clan-marks older than the elder

encounters.prose_label: Shards of impact silica glass in the erg
encounters.sensory_hook: Pale green, warm, too smooth — picked up, pocketed, uneasy

encounters.prose_label: Haboob / dust wall on the southern horizon
encounters.sensory_hook: Ozone taste, a drop of ten degrees, hands on the lead-line

encounters.prose_label: Addax or dorcas gazelle track crossing
encounters.sensory_hook: Cloven prints already softening at the edges

encounters.prose_label: Striped hyena circling the camp
encounters.sensory_hook: A cough-laugh from beyond the firelight's throw

encounters.prose_label: North African ostrich sighted far south
encounters.sensory_hook: Two black commas moving against heat-shimmer

encounters.prose_label: Caravan-hand lost from the line in blowing sand
encounters.sensory_hook: The moment the rope goes slack — and he is already dead

encounters.prose_label: Customs inspector at the dogana weigh-beam
encounters.sensory_hook: Cold clank of the bronze weigh-pan, consul's dragoman palming his cut

encounters.prose_label: Muezzin-analog call answered by fondaco bell across the water
encounters.sensory_hook: Two faiths' hours overlapping on the same limestone quay

encounters.prose_label: Mattanza-style tuna haul landing at the fish market
encounters.sensory_hook: Bluefin still twitching on bloody stone, gulls screaming

encounters.prose_label: Polyglot wine-shop argument in six tongues
encounters.sensory_hook: Arabic-analog, Turkic-analog, Malay pidgin, clicks and ejectives, one jar of resinated wine

encounters.prose_label: Caravanserai: desert train and steppe train in same courtyard
encounters.sensory_hook: Camel-groan, fountain-plash, hammam steam, three prayer-bells at once

encounters.prose_label: Corsair raid on a dead calm
encounters.sensory_hook: The peculiar quiet of sailless ships; oar-creak where no oar should be

encounters.prose_label: Autumn gale driving ships onto a lee shore
encounters.sensory_hook: Pilot's stare at a blackening horizon

encounters.prose_label: Press-gang trawling the tavern district
encounters.sensory_hook: A sudden hush in the song, boots on wet cobble

encounters.prose_label: Money-changer settling a fifteen-way account
encounters.sensory_hook: Tick-tick of the touchstone; comparative tables made audible

encounters.prose_label: Bottlenose dolphins riding the bow-wave
encounters.sensory_hook: Wet exhale at the gunwale; sailors take it as good omen

encounters.prose_label: Flamingo flock on a coastal salt-pan
encounters.sensory_hook: Pink wading line against white salt

encounters.prose_label: Fever-quarter sluggish reach in summer
encounters.sensory_hook: Rot-smell at a dead tide, rent doubled on the uphill side

encounters.prose_label: Hauled-out galley being caulked for mare clausum
encounters.sensory_hook: Tar-pot bubbling, caulkers' mallets in syncopation

encounters.prose_label: Pilgrim galley disembarking in confusion
encounters.sensory_hook: Vermin, vomit, dragoman's stick

encounters.prose_label: Monk seal hauled out on an uninhabited stack
encounters.sensory_hook: The pilot lowers his voice; sailors call it lucky and do not point

encounters.prose_label: Fin whale blowing on the open crossing
encounters.sensory_hook: A single tall spout far out on the swell, then nothing

encounters.prose_label: Great white shouldering past the rudder
encounters.sensory_hook: A grey weight in the wake, gone before the shout; the helm says nothing till landfall
